Models

Source: vignettes/articles/models.qmd

Every model medfit can run, in one place. Find yours in the first table, then open its page. For a one-page lookup of every function see the Reference Card; for short task recipes see the Cookbook.

Find your model

I have Page
One mediator, a continuous outcome Simple mediation
A binary or count outcome, or a binary mediator Binary and non-normal variables
An effect of the mediator that depends on the treatment Treatment-by-mediator interaction
Inverse-probability weights or case weights Weights and robust SEs
The closed-form regression engine The regmedint engine
Mediators in a chain (M1 drives M2) Serial mediation
Mediators side by side Parallel mediation
Several mediators and treatment-by-mediator products Joint mediation
Treatment assigned to whole clusters Cluster-randomized trials
A lavaan fit lavaan fits
A model written as syntax, with defined parameters Native: paths and defined parameters
A latent mediator Native: a latent mediator
Constraints, or a test of the indirect effect Native: constraints and MBCO
Serial or parallel mediators, or weights, in syntax Native: several mediators and weights

Capabilities at a glance

Model Class Engines and routes Standard errors Page
Simple MediationData glm, regmedint, extract_mediation() (lm/glm, lavaan), native model, sandwich simple
Binary or count variables MediationData glm families model, sandwich glm families
Treatment-by-mediator InteractionMediationData glm, regmedint, lavaan model; closed form (regmedint) interaction
Weighted MediationData glm; native weights sandwich (HC3; native HC0-type) weights
Serial SerialMediationData lm/glm with mediator_models, lavaan, native via fit_sem() model serial
Parallel ParallelMediationData lm/glm, lavaan, native via fit_sem() model parallel
Joint, with products JointMediationData lm fits delta method, bootstrap joint
Cluster-level treatment (2-1-1) ClusterMediationData lmer fits or engine = "lmer" model, Kenward-Roger ("kr") cluster
Latent mediator, constraints SEMFit, then extracted fit_sem(), engine = "native" (experimental) model, sandwich native, latent

Inference works on every row: delta-method intervals from tidy() and confint(), and the parametric, nonparametric and plugin bootstrap (see Bootstrap Inference).

The native engine takes one mediator in fit_mediation()

fit_mediation(engine = "native", model = ) accepts a single mediator. For several mediators, fit the syntax with fit_sem() (see Native: several mediators and weights) and then call extract_mediation(fit, mediator = c(...), outcome = ), with structure = "parallel" for side-by-side mediators.

What medfit does not run

  • Treatment varying within clusters (1-1-1), and non-Gaussian outcomes or mediators in the cluster design.
  • Four-way or joint decompositions with non-Gaussian models.
  • Latent means (a free latent mean or intercept) on the native engine, and products with a latent variable. Observed intercepts and means (y ~ 1, meanstructure =) and the observed product x:m with its four-way decomposition are supported.
  • Bayesian fits through brms (planned).

See Methods and Formulas for the assumptions behind each model.
